credit: First 13 Life entries are adaptations of wiki-documented notes. Remaining 62 entries are original fan-written additions, not official game text.

0-0.description: A beginner’s brew with mild healing and no aroma.
0-0.bottle_note: Keep chilled; use within a day.

0-1.description: A sticky little remedy for childhood colds.

0-2.description: A fruity dessert drink with an enthusiastic following.
0-2.bottle_note: The cap says: better luck next time.

0-3.description: Pocket-sized healing, with a bitter finish.
0-3.bottle_note: Alex awards three stars for speedy delivery.

0-4.description: A nourishing refreshment with a vegetable-like taste.
0-4.bottle_note: Avoid bottles with damaged seals or changed contents.

0-5.description: A household staple for weary afternoons.
0-5.bottle_note: Jake gives one star: unpleasant flavor.

0-6.description: The traveler’s dependable, unremarkable everyday tonic.
0-6.bottle_note: Report suspicious potions at the village office.

0-7.bottle_note: The nutrition panel promises strength without trans fats.

0-8.description: A handsome oversized bottle for lengthy journeys.
0-8.bottle_note: A month-long special on the large-bottle range.

0-9.description: A sacred blessing, with fairly ordinary healing.
0-9.bottle_note: A paladin’s sword-blessing review trails off…

0-10.description: Sweet fruit suspended in a jelly-like potion.
0-10.bottle_note: Dungeon monsters may follow its scent.

0-11.description: Briefly borrowed strength, followed by lingering side effects.
0-11.bottle_note: Repeated doses may blur friend and foe.

0-12.description: A luminous gift that doubles as decoration.
0-12.bottle_note: Apparently, this one needs a power socket.

0-13.description: Distilled through silver petals, this deep crimson tonic closes scrapes and restores a weary traveler's color.
0-13.bottle_note: The cork squeaks whenever someone calls it ordinary.

0-14.description: A peppery orange-red draught that cools the skin beneath an oven's fiercest breath.
0-14.bottle_note: Bakers insist it works; their bread remains unimpressed.

0-15.description: Thick with golden roots, this ruby syrup returns warmth to limbs chilled by long expeditions.
0-15.bottle_note: Shake gently; the sediment dislikes being hurried.

0-16.description: A fierce scarlet cordial that lends bruised fighters renewed force and very loud opinions.
0-16.bottle_note: Not recommended during delicate negotiations or family dinners.

0-17.description: Stars drift through its rose-colored depths, lending fragile bodies the comfort of morning sunlight.
0-17.bottle_note: Store away from windows; it tries to greet the moon.

0-18.description: Steeped in forgotten herbs, this dusky brew mends weariness with patient, old-fashioned magic.
0-18.bottle_note: The recipe predates labels, but the bottle insists on one.

0-19.description: A regal crimson elixir that steadies failing knees and makes old battle scars shimmer.
0-19.bottle_note: Heroes praise it; their squires complain about the storytelling afterward.

0-20.description: First light caught in amber glass wakes warmth in even the most exhausted traveler.
0-20.bottle_note: Uncork at sunrise for best results, or whenever the shop opens.

0-21.description: Dark ribbons coil inside this forbidden restorative, knitting strength with an unsettling chill.
0-21.bottle_note: Returns accepted only if the bottle stops whispering your name.

0-22.description: A smoky red tonic grants infernal resilience, though its aftertaste resembles burnt plum jam.
0-22.bottle_note: Infernal supplier demands praise; customers mostly request smaller spoons.

0-23.description: A potent garnet serum restores warmth to those touched by an invented crimson blight.
0-23.bottle_note: The quarantine stamp is decorative; village clerks remain suspicious.

0-24.description: A royal scarlet essence renews battered strength while polishing its drinker's posture to perfection.
0-24.bottle_note: Complaints must be addressed to the reflection in the cap.

1-0.description: A pale blue trial brew that briefly sharpens the mind for beginner spells.
1-0.bottle_note: Complimentary samples exclude the tiny measuring spoon.

1-1.description: A soft lavender sip encourages harmless sparks and picture-book daydreams in young apprentices.
1-1.bottle_note: Please keep away from curtains and excitable grandmothers.

1-2.description: Sweet forest berries lend this blue cordial a pleasant taste and a flicker of insight.
1-2.bottle_note: One customer mistook the ink stain for a signature.

1-3.description: A thimbleful of clear azure liquid keeps minor charms from slipping out of memory.
1-3.bottle_note: The bottle is easier to lose than the spell.

1-4.description: Sparkling with powdered quartz, this bracing mineral tonic steadies concentration without much flavor.
1-4.bottle_note: Do not confuse the decorative pebbles with sweets.

1-5.description: A kitchen-brewed blue infusion clears sleepy thoughts before letters, ledgers, and simple enchantments.
1-5.bottle_note: Grandmother says the secret ingredient is proper stirring.

1-6.description: A familiar indigo draught restores focus after an afternoon of routine wand practice.
1-6.bottle_note: The academy buys it in bulk, reluctantly.

1-7.description: Bright bubbles tickle the tongue and scatter fresh ideas across the mind.
1-7.bottle_note: Open slowly unless you want the ceiling to learn spells.

1-8.description: A tall blue flask offers steady magical clarity through drawn-out rituals and tedious meetings.
1-8.bottle_note: No shelf in the shop is quite tall enough.

1-9.description: A drop of temple light turns this blue draught serene and surprisingly useful for prayer.
1-9.bottle_note: Blessed by a priest who forgot where he put the invoice.

1-10.description: Purple grape skins give this spell tonic a rich sweetness and unusually vivid mental pictures.
1-10.bottle_note: A vintner called it excellent, then asked for a refund.

1-11.description: Velvety sapphire liquid settles scattered thoughts and makes difficult questions feel almost politely answerable.
1-11.bottle_note: Does not prevent the drinker from asking foolish questions.

1-12.description: A glow like bottled starlight guides wandering ideas back into a spellcaster's grasp.
1-12.bottle_note: Cover after bedtime; neighboring owls have filed complaints.

1-13.description: Refined beneath a glass moon, this deep blue potion lends precision to ambitious incantations.
1-13.bottle_note: The etched instructions require excellent eyesight or a magnifying charm.

1-14.description: An oddly warming sapphire brew keeps fingers nimble while frost spells whisper through the air.
1-14.bottle_note: Leave beside the hearth; it prefers the irony.

1-15.description: Concentrated blue petals dissolve into a silken draught that sustains careful, intricate spellwork.
1-15.bottle_note: Sediment forms tiny runes nobody has managed to translate.

1-16.description: A cloudless blue elixir quiets racing thoughts without dulling a mage's curiosity.
1-16.bottle_note: Customer returned it because the silence felt suspicious.

1-17.description: Silver constellations swim in liquid midnight, arranging stray thoughts into graceful patterns of magic.
1-17.bottle_note: Do not shake; astronomers dislike having their maps rearranged.

1-18.description: Made from a scholar's lost formula, this murky blue brew recalls forgotten magical principles.
1-18.bottle_note: The instructions are written in a language the bottle claims to know.

1-19.description: A pearlescent potion opens doorways in the imagination, where impossible spells first take shape.
1-19.bottle_note: Dream creatures are not eligible for the loyalty card.

1-20.description: A pale horizon glimmers within this elixir, granting fresh focus after long nights of study.
1-20.bottle_note: Morning birds gather nearby, hoping to borrow its brightness.

1-21.description: Ash flecks whirl through haunted blue fluid, revealing secrets best handled with cautious curiosity.
1-21.bottle_note: Never pour near open books; the margins begin arguing.

1-22.description: Cold cobalt fire sharpens infernal spellcraft while leaving the tongue tasting faintly of soot.
1-22.bottle_note: A tiny contract appears beneath the label when warmed.

1-23.description: This spectral blue serum restores coherence to thoughts muddled by a mythical dreaming sickness.
1-23.bottle_note: Keep separate from lullabies; the contents grow unusually drowsy.

1-24.description: A majestic blue essence lends command over elusive spells and an unfortunate fondness for speeches.
1-24.bottle_note: The mirror seal approves every incantation, even the dreadful ones.

2-0.description: A sunny beginner's tonic lends enough spring to finish ordinary chores with a smile.
2-0.bottle_note: Sample bottles are not intended for marathon sweeping.

2-1.description: This mild golden syrup makes small feet eager for another lap around the garden.
2-1.bottle_note: Keep the lid tight; the nursery already has enough excitement.

2-2.description: Sweet orange peel brightens a cheerful draught for messengers with errands left to run.
2-2.bottle_note: Best served cool, according to three overheated couriers.

2-3.description: A thumb-sized yellow dose loosens stiff legs after climbing too many village stairs.
2-3.bottle_note: The label recommends resting anyway, which customers find unhelpful.

2-4.description: Golden herbs and orchard greens make a lively tonic for dull, dragging mornings.
2-4.bottle_note: The herbalist insists the grassy smell means quality.

2-5.description: A honey-colored kitchen brew lends tired hands the resolve to finish the washing.
2-5.bottle_note: Uncle Finn claims it also improves his singing; nobody agrees.

2-6.description: This plain yellow pick-me-up keeps weary travelers walking comfortably until the next inn.
2-6.bottle_note: Popular with caravan guards, unpopular with sore boots.

2-7.description: Tart lemon fizz puts a bounce in sluggish steps and a sparkle on the tongue.
2-7.bottle_note: Unscrew over the sink; the bubbles are eager to escape.

2-8.description: A generous flask of liquid sunshine sustains long hikes across hills and muddy roads.
2-8.bottle_note: The carrying strap costs extra and occasionally carries itself.

2-9.description: A warm temple-made tonic gives pilgrims the endurance to reach one more roadside shrine.
2-9.bottle_note: Clerics recommend sensible footwear alongside the blessing.

2-10.description: This puzzling yellow potion lends restless wanderers stamina whenever they solve its shifting label.
2-10.bottle_note: Most customers simply ask the shopkeeper for the answer.

2-11.description: Golden sparks race through this lively elixir, lifting the heaviness from overworked limbs.
2-11.bottle_note: Advised against opening indoors; the cork likes to sprint.

2-12.description: Sunlit motes drift through honey-yellow glass, cheering exhausted feet across twilight paths.
2-12.bottle_note: The glow attracts moths who expect free refreshments.

2-13.description: A golden distillate restores steady movement during punishing marches and overly ambitious expeditions.
2-13.bottle_note: Measured doses are marked by tiny marching boots.

2-14.description: Amber threads flicker inside this tangy brew, helping travelers weather crackling storm magic.
2-14.bottle_note: Please avoid rubbing the bottle on woolen cloaks.

2-15.description: Pressed from sunroot and hardy mountain thyme, this dense tonic carries tired legs farther.
2-15.bottle_note: Leaves a yellow ring on every respectable tablecloth.

2-16.description: A bold citrus elixir revives aching muscles and an adventurer's willingness to climb again.
2-16.bottle_note: One customer requested stairs to test it; we declined.

2-17.description: A miniature sunrise spins inside this golden potion, keeping footsteps lively under distant stars.
2-17.bottle_note: Close the shutters; it confuses the household rooster.

2-18.description: An aged amber recipe restores the patient endurance of travelers from forgotten kingdoms.
2-18.bottle_note: The stopper bears a map to an inn no longer standing.

2-19.description: A blazing yellow draught lends heroic stamina to those carrying burdens both noble and mundane.
2-19.bottle_note: Heroes may claim discounted saddlebags, subject to availability.

2-20.description: Violet shadows blend with gold, easing the final weary steps before evening shelter.
2-20.bottle_note: Perfect for homeward journeys; not an excuse to miss supper.

2-21.description: An amber curse burns softly inside this reagent, urging exhausted travelers onward past reason.
2-21.bottle_note: Its shadow always points toward the nearest empty chair.

2-22.description: A brimstone-yellow cordial grants relentless footwork, though the soles of boots grow uncomfortably warm.
2-22.bottle_note: Infernal warranty excludes melted shoelaces and complaints about dancing.

2-23.description: This uncanny gold serum steadies limbs weakened by the legendary sleepwalking blight.
2-23.bottle_note: Town watchmen demand a signed note before night walks.

2-24.description: Liquid gold rolls like sunlight, granting magnificent endurance and a rather theatrical stride.
2-24.bottle_note: The cap doubles as a crown for particularly self-important purchasers.

generated_provenance: Original fan-written flavor text inspired by documented Potion Maker descriptions; not official game text.
